content.comment_body: Product discontinuation: [product_name] [version_no] The [company_name] [product_name] [version_no] will no longer be available starting February 28, 2019.

analysis.insight_summary: Users have been notified about the upcoming discontinuation of [product_name] [version_no], which may affect those who rely on this hardware for current or future projects, and leads to concerns regarding future support and product availability.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect prompt notification regarding product discontinuation, information about alternative products, and continued support options after the official end of product availability.
